While EBITDA margin contracted to 22.8%, PAT growth remained healthy at 16.0% YoY, surpassing our estimate.
We expect H2FY27 revenue momentum to improve, supported by higher execution across HTT-40, Dhruv NG, ALH, Su-30MKI and AL-31FP engine programmes.
Additionally, improved engine availability and progress on Tejas-Mk1A are likely to support the commencement of deliveries, providing further impetus to revenue growth.

View & valuation: We maintain a positive stance on HAL, supported by its strategic positioning in India's defence ecosystem and the anticipated ramp-up in manufacturing programmes.
We maintain our 'BUY' rating with a target price of INR 5,750, valuing the stock at 30x average FY28E–FY29E EPS.
watch: We believe the gradual shift, from the current MRO-heavy revenue mix towards manufacturing, alongside the scaling up of key platforms, could drive sustained revenue growth, operating leverage & margin improvement.
